title: Trace European Soil upper reader sites
changes: Record filtered reader-site evidence for the remaining sampled EUR Soil Evidence upper ROM reads.
validation: Wine capture e285-soil-upper-sites-wine-wgddtcdt observes all 285 E240 residual bytes over 600 retained frames; 245 bytes occur in interpreter scopes and 40 remain outside those scopes.
limitations: The inventory does not prove exact readers, source formats, extents, state equivalence or ownership; interpreter scopes can include nested reads.
Other continuations, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open; no performance comparison was performed.
